# Section 7: Kiln KLN-01 Heat-Up and Start-Up (Control Narrative)

**Revision:** A (draft for operations review) · **Date:** 2026-10-19 · **Status:** Not approved. Operations sign-off is required (Section 7.12).

> **Note on tags.** No instrument index was given. All tag numbers below are proposed placeholders. Replace them with plant tags before review. All values are in the setpoint list (Section 7.11). Values marked "confirm" are proposals, not plant data.

**Verification rule.** Each FR is tested at FAT by simulation and at SAT by a witnessed run or a forced input. A row states a different method if one applies.

---

## 7.1 Purpose and boundaries

This section specifies how the kiln goes from cold shutdown to feed-on. The scope covers main burner light-off on diesel, the controlled heat-up, the change from diesel to coal, kiln rotation during heat-up, the change from aux drive to main drive, and feed introduction. It also covers the response to power loss during heat-up.

| Interface | Module | What crosses the boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Upstream | Kiln feed system (FDS) | Feed ready status; WIC-701 setpoint |
| Upstream | Coal grinding/dosing (CMS) | Coal ready status; WIC-411 and WIC-421 setpoints |
| Peer | Main burner BMS-401, calciner BMS-421 | Purge, ignition, flame proven, fuel trip. BMS logic is in the BMS specification. |
| Peer | Clinker cooler (CLR) | "Cooler in heat-up mode" status. Cooler control is in the CLR narrative. |
| Downstream | ESP EP-801 | HT energize permissive and trip |
| Downstream | Normal operation (Section 8) | Handover at state S80 |
| Safety | SRS-KLN | Candidate SIFs (FR-KLN-103, FR-KLN-104) |

## 7.3 States and transitions (ISA-106)

The kiln uses state-based control for the heat-up states. Discrete jobs use sequences (Section 7.5).

### 7.3.1 Kiln process states

| FR | State | Entry permissives | Allowed exits | Initiator | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-001 | S00 COLD SHUTDOWN | No flame proven. TT-301 below SP-51. | S10 | Operator | Manual |
| FR-KLN-002 | S10 PURGE | All fuel valves proven closed. WIC-411 and WIC-421 stopped. WIC-701 stopped. FN-501 running at or above SP-22. FN-402 running. CLR in heat-up mode. M-602 available. All interlocks reset. | S20 when BMS-401 reports purge complete. S99 on purge failure. | Operator | Operator-initiated, BMS automatic |
| FR-KLN-003 | S20 DIESEL LIGHT-OFF | BMS-401 purge complete | S30 on BS-401 flame proven. S99 on ignition failure. | Auto | Automatic (BMS) |
| FR-KLN-004 | S30 DIESEL HEAT-UP | Diesel flame proven | S40, S90, S99 | Auto | Automatic |
| FR-KLN-005 | S40 FUEL CHANGEOVER | TT-301 at or above SP-10. CMS reports coal ready. | S50 on SEQ-KLN-02 complete. S30 on coal failure. S90, S99. | Operator accepts prompt PR-02 | Operator-prompted |
| FR-KLN-006 | S50 COAL HEAT-UP | Coal flame proven. Diesel off. | S60, S90, S99 | Auto | Automatic |
| FR-KLN-007 | S60 READY FOR FEED | TT-301 at or above SP-14. TT-311 at or above SP-15. Rotation state R3. | S70, S90, S99 | Auto | Automatic |
| FR-KLN-008 | S70 FEED RAMP | All S60 conditions. FDS ready. EP-801 energized (confirm, OI-07). AT-321 CO below SP-24. | S80, S90, S99 | Operator accepts prompt PR-05 | Operator-prompted |
| FR-KLN-009 | S80 FEED ON | WIC-701 at 100 % of SP-17 | Handover to Section 8. S99. | Auto | Automatic |
| FR-KLN-010 | S90 HOLD | Any hold cause (Section 7.3.3) or operator HOLD | Return to the state of origin when causes are clear and the operator pushes RESUME. S99. | Auto or operator | Automatic entry, operator exit |
| FR-KLN-011 | S99 TRIP | Any fuel trip (FR-KLN-101, FR-KLN-102) or main power loss | S10 after the interlocks are reset. S00 when TT-301 is below SP-51. | Auto | Automatic entry, operator exit |

**FR-KLN-012 (Hot restart).** Every restart from S99 goes through S10 and S20. At S30 entry, the ramp setpoint starts from the present TT-301 value. If TT-301 is already at or above SP-10, PR-02 shows immediately.

### 7.3.2 Kiln rotation states (run parallel to 7.3.1)

> **WARNING:** Make sure that the kiln drive, tyre, and girth gear areas are clear before you enable AUTO TURN. The kiln can turn after the XA-603 warning only.

| FR | State | Entry condition | Behavior | Exit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-020 | R0 STATIONARY | TT-301 below SP-51 and no flame | No automatic rotation | R1 |
| FR-KLN-021 | R1 INTERMITTENT AUX | Flame proven or TT-301 at or above SP-51, and AUTO TURN enabled | SEQ-KLN-03 at the interval for the present TT-301 band (SP-36 to SP-43) | R2, R0 |
| FR-KLN-022 | R2 CONTINUOUS AUX | TT-301 at or above SP-39 | M-602 runs continuously | R3 through SEQ-KLN-04 |
| FR-KLN-023 | R3 MAIN DRIVE | SEQ-KLN-04 complete | M-601 runs at SP-45 or higher | R2 on M-601 trip. R4 on power loss. |
| FR-KLN-024 | R4 EMERGENCY AUX | Main power loss with TT-301 at or above SP-51 | SEQ-KLN-06 | R1 or R2 when main power is restored and the operator accepts PR-07 |

**FR-KLN-025 (Band selection).** The system selects the rotation band from TT-301 automatically. The operator can select a more frequent band or continuous rotation. The operator cannot select a less frequent band. A field LOCAL STOP always stops the drive and raises ALM-KLN-09.

### 7.3.3 Hold causes and hold behavior

**FR-KLN-013 (Hold causes).** The system goes to S90 when one of these occurs:
- the operator pushes HOLD;
- TI-650 is at or above SP-31;
- the measured TT-301 rate of rise exceeds SP-05 over the SP-06 window;
- TT-301A and TT-301B are both bad;
- TI-650 is bad while the kiln turns;
- in S70 only: TT-301 is below SP-19, or AT-321 CO is at or above SP-24.

**FR-KLN-014 (Hold behavior).** In S90, the ramp setpoint stops at its present value. TIC-301 continues to control at that value. Kiln rotation continues. The feed setpoint stops at its present value. In S90 the system does not stop the feed or the fuel.

**FR-KLN-015 (Hold duration).** If S90 lasts longer than SP-49, the system raises ALM-KLN-12.

**Test notes:**
- **FR-KLN-034:** At FAT, enter an ID fan speed below SP-22 in MAN while the simulated flame is on. The system must reject the entry.

## 7.5 Sequences

### SEQ-KLN-01 Light-off (S10 to S30)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (FR-KLN-040) | Check S10 permissives. Show missing items on the permissive list. | All permissives true | None (waits) | Light-off is blocked. Missing items show on HMI. |
| 2 (FR-KLN-041) | Send the purge request to BMS-401 | BMS-401 purge complete | BMS purge time plus SP-55 | S99, ALM-KLN-01 |
| 3 (FR-KLN-042) | BMS-401 lights the diesel at SP-09 | BS-401 flame proven | BMS ignition trial time | BMS-401 closes XV-401/402. S99. |
| 4 (FR-KLN-043) | Start the ramp at present TT-301. Set TIC-301 to AUTO. Enable rotation state R1. | Done | SP-56 | S90, ALM-KLN-11 |

### SEQ-KLN-02 Fuel changeover (S40)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (FR-KLN-050) | Show PR-02. Wait for operator acceptance. | Operator accepts | None | Stay in S30. Ramp continues. |
| 2 (FR-KLN-051) | Request coal start from BMS-401 and CMS. Start WIC-411 at minimum. | BMS-401 coal flame proven | SP-13 | BMS stops coal. Return to S30. ALM-KLN-02. |
| 3 (FR-KLN-052) | Decrease diesel to SP-09 over SP-11. TIC-301 adds coal to hold the ramp. | Diesel at SP-09 | SP-11 plus SP-13 | If TT-301 falls more than SP-12, stop the diesel decrease and show PR-03. |
| 4 (FR-KLN-053) | BMS-401 closes the diesel. | XV-401/402 proven closed and coal flame proven | SP-56 | ALM-KLN-02. Stay in S40. Show PR-03. |
| 5 (FR-KLN-054) | Move TIC-301 output to WIC-411 only | Done | SP-56 | S90 |

### SEQ-KLN-03 Intermittent turn (R1)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (FR-KLN-060) | Count the band interval (SP-40 to SP-43) | Interval complete | — | — |
| 2 (FR-KLN-061) | Operate XA-603 for SP-34 | Warning time complete | SP-34 | — |
| 3 (FR-KLN-062) | Make sure that ZS-602 shows engaged. Start M-602. | M-602 running | SP-56 | ALM-KLN-08. Do one retry. Then show PR-06. |
| 4 (FR-KLN-063) | Run until ST-601 counts SP-33 | Count reached | SP-35 | Stop M-602. ALM-KLN-08. Show PR-06. |
| 5 (FR-KLN-064) | Stop M-602. Apply the brake. Start the next interval. | M-602 stopped | SP-56 | ALM-KLN-08 |

**FR-KLN-065 (Turn on LOCAL STOP).** If LOCAL STOP operates during a turn, the turn stops. The system raises ALM-KLN-09. The interval timer continues.

### SEQ-KLN-04 Aux drive to main drive (R2 to R3)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (FR-KLN-070) | When TT-301 is at or above SP-44, show PR-04 | Operator accepts | None | Stay in R2 |
| 2 (FR-KLN-071) | Operate XA-603 for SP-34. Stop M-602. Apply the brake. | M-602 stopped | SP-56 | ALM-KLN-08. Stay in R2. |
| 3 (FR-KLN-072) | Disengage the clutch | ZS-602 shows disengaged | SP-46 total stationary time for steps 3 to 5 | Engage the clutch. Restart M-602. Stay in R2. ALM-KLN-08. |
| 4 (FR-KLN-073) | Start M-601 at SP-45 | M-601 running | Same | Same |
| 5 (FR-KLN-074) | Confirm rotation | ST-601 pulses received | Same | Stop M-601. Same as above. |

### SEQ-KLN-05 Feed introduction (S60 to S80)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (FR-KLN-080) | Show PR-05 with the S70 permissive list | Operator accepts and permissives true | None | Stay in S60 |
| 2 (FR-KLN-081) | Request FDS start. Set WIC-701 to SP-16 of SP-17. | Feed rate within SP-57 of SP | SP-58 | Stop WIC-701. Return to S60. ALM-KLN-13. |
| 3 (FR-KLN-082) | Ramp WIC-701 to 100 % of SP-17 over SP-18. SIC-601 follows (FR-KLN-036). | Feed at 100 % | SP-18 plus total hold time | Ramp stops in S90 |
| 4 (FR-KLN-083) | When TT-331 is at or above SP-20 and feed is at or above SP-21, show PR-08 for calciner light-off. BMS-421 lights the calciner. | Calciner flame proven | BMS-421 time | BMS-421 trips the calciner. ALM-KLN-14. Ramp stops at present feed. |
| 5 (FR-KLN-084) | Go to S80. Hand over to Section 8. | Done | SP-56 | — |

### SEQ-KLN-06 Power-loss turning (R4)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (FR-KLN-090) | Detect main bus loss. Fail positions apply (Section 7.8.4). S99. | Bus loss | — | — |
| 2 (FR-KLN-091) | G-901 starts automatically and closes onto the emergency bus | Emergency bus live | SP-47 | ALM-KLN-10 (urgent). Show PR-09 (manual barring, OI-09). |
| 3 (FR-KLN-092) | Start M-602: continuous if TT-301 is at or above SP-39, or the band interval if TT-301 is below SP-39 | M-602 running | SP-47 from bus loss | ALM-KLN-10. Show PR-09. |
| 4 (FR-KLN-093) | Continue until main power returns or TT-301 is below SP-51 | — | — | — |

**FR-KLN-094 (DCS power).** The DCS controller and I/O for M-602, ST-601, TT-301A/B, and XA-603 are on UPS. Test method: SAT, with main power isolated.

## 7.6 Interlocks and permissives (cause-and-effect rows)

No cause-and-effect chart was given. Transfer these rows to the chart before issue.

| FR | Cause | Effect | Latched / auto-reset | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-101 | FN-501 stopped, or speed feedback below SP-22 for SP-23, while any flame is proven | BMS-401 and BMS-421 trip all fuel. WIC-701 stops. S99. | Latched | Cause clear, then operator reset at BMS, then purge |
| FR-KLN-102 | BMS-401 or BMS-421 flame failure | That burner's fuel trips (BMS spec). If both burners trip: WIC-701 stops, S99. | Latched | BMS reset, then purge |
| FR-KLN-103 | AT-321 CO at or above SP-25 | EP-801 HT sets de-energize | Latched | CO below SP-26 for SP-27, then operator reset. *Candidate SIF: integrity per SRS-KLN.* |
| FR-KLN-104 | AT-321 fault for SP-29. A blowback hold up to SP-28 is not a fault. | EP-801 HT sets de-energize | Latched | Analyzer healthy, then FR-KLN-103 reset conditions, then operator reset. *Candidate SIF.* |
| FR-KLN-105 | M-601 stopped while WIC-701 runs | WIC-701 stops | Latched | Operator restarts feed through SEQ-KLN-05 |
| FR-KLN-106 | WIC-701 stopped | Calciner fuel trips (BMS-421) | Latched | BMS-421 reset |
| FR-KLN-107 | ZS-602 engaged | M-601 start blocked | Auto-reset | — |
| FR-KLN-108 | M-601 running | M-602 start blocked | Auto-reset | — |
| FR-KLN-109 | Feed below SP-21 or TT-331 below SP-20 | Calciner light-off blocked | Auto-reset | — |
| FR-KLN-110 | EP-801 HT energize request | Blocked until AT-321 CO is below SP-26 for SP-27 | Auto-reset | — |

**FR-KLN-111 (Bypasses).** The DCS cannot bypass FR-KLN-101 to FR-KLN-104. Bypasses follow the plant bypass procedure.

## 7.7 Alarms

No rationalized alarm database was given. Priorities are proposals for the ISA-18.2 rationalization.

| ID | Tag | Condition | Priority | Operator response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ALM-KLN-01 | BMS-401 | Purge or ignition failure | High | Find the cause on the BMS first-out display. Reset. Start again from S10. |
| ALM-KLN-02 | BMS-401 / WIC-411 | Coal start failure in S40 | High | Check the coal supply and the primary air. Accept PR-02 again. |
| ALM-KLN-03 | TT-301 | Rate of rise above SP-05 | High | Decrease the ramp rate. Examine TI-650. Push RESUME. |
| ALM-KLN-04 | TI-650 | At or above SP-30 | High | Examine the scanner trend. Speak to the shift supervisor. |
| ALM-KLN-05 | TI-650 | At or above SP-31 (system goes to S90) | Urgent | Do a field check of the shell. Decide continue or cool down. |
| ALM-KLN-06 | AT-321 | CO at or above SP-24 | High | Decrease fuel. Increase FN-501 speed. Examine the burner flame. |
| ALM-KLN-07 | AT-321 | CO trip of EP-801 | Urgent | Find the cause of the CO. Reset when FR-KLN-103 permits. |
| ALM-KLN-08 | M-601 / M-602 | Turn or drive change failed | High | Turn the kiln by hand control (PR-06). Call electrical. |
| ALM-KLN-09 | M-602 | LOCAL STOP during auto turning | High | Find out who stopped it. Restart turning as soon as the area is clear. |
| ALM-KLN-10 | G-901 / M-602 | No rotation within SP-47 after power loss | Urgent | Start manual barring (PR-09). |
| ALM-KLN-11 | TT-301A/B | One bad, or deviation above SP-32 | High | Call instruments. Monitor the selected value. |
| ALM-KLN-12 | KLN-01 | S90 longer than SP-49 | Low | Decide resume or cool down. |
| ALM-KLN-13 | WIC-701 | Feed start failure | High | Check FDS. Accept PR-05 again. |
| ALM-KLN-14 | BMS-421 | Calciner light-off failure | High | Check the calciner coal supply. Accept PR-08 again. |
| ALM-KLN-15 | Rotation | Kiln stationary with TT-301 at or above SP-51 for longer than band interval plus SP-35 | Urgent | Turn the kiln now. |

## 7.8 Abnormal handling

### 7.8.1 Bad PV

| FR | Signal | Response |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-140 | TT-301A or TT-301B | Both healthy: use the higher value. One bad: use the other one and raise ALM-KLN-11. Both bad: S90, fuel demand stops at present value, rotation keeps the last band, show PR-03. |
| FR-KLN-141 | TT-311 | Feed permissive is blocked. Feed already on: alarm only. |
| FR-KLN-142 | AT-321 | Per FR-KLN-104 |
| FR-KLN-143 | AT-301 | SIC-501 goes to MAN at present output. ALM raised. |
| FR-KLN-144 | TI-650 | Invalid while the kiln is stationary: no alarm. Bad while the kiln turns: S90. The operator can push RESUME after a field shell check. |
| FR-KLN-145 | ST-601 | SEQ-KLN-03 step 4 uses a run time of SP-53. ALM raised. |
| FR-KLN-146 | TT-331 | Calciner light-off is blocked |

### 7.8.2 Communications loss

| FR | Link | Response |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-150 | DCS to BMS-401 / BMS-421 | BMS trips are hardwired and unchanged. DCS goes to S90. |
| FR-KLN-151 | DCS to FN-501 VFD | VFD holds last speed. The VFD does not stop. ALM raised. |
| FR-KLN-152 | DCS to M-602 panel | The panel continues turning on a local backup timer at the last band (OI-08) |
| FR-KLN-153 | DCS to WIC-701 | Feed stops |
| FR-KLN-154 | DCS to WIC-411 / WIC-421 | Feeders hold last rate. The BMS supervises the flame. ALM raised. |

Comms loss is declared after watchdog time SP-54.

### 7.8.3 Power loss and controller restart

- **FR-KLN-160 (Power loss).** SEQ-KLN-06 applies.
- **FR-KLN-161 (Power return).** The system stays in S99. It does not restart fuel, feed, or FN-501 automatically. The operator restarts from S10.
- **FR-KLN-162 (DCS controller restart).**
  - If no flame is proven, the state becomes S99. All fuel and feed outputs initialize to off.
  - If a flame is proven, the state becomes S90 and the ramp starts again from present PV.
  - In both cases, rotation continues at the band for the present TT-301.

### 7.8.4 Fail positions

| Device | Fail position |
|---|---|
| XV-401 / XV-402 | Closed |
| FV-401 | Closed |
| WIC-411, WIC-421, WIC-701 | Stopped |
| FN-501 | Stopped on power loss. Holds last speed on comms loss. |
| M-601 | Stopped |
| M-602 brake | Applied |
| EP-801 HT | De-energized |
| FN-402 | Stopped on power loss (burner tip cooling: OI-10) |

## 7.9 Operator interface

The heat-up display shows:
- the present kiln state and rotation state;
- TT-301 PV, ramp SP, and measured rate, on one trend;
- a countdown to the next turn, and the band in use;
- the permissive list for the next transition;
- TI-650, AT-321 CO, and the FN-501 speed against the SP-22 clamp.

The operator can change the ramp rate (between SP-03 and SP-02), HOLD, RESUME, the rotation band (more frequent only), and the loop modes.

| Prompt | Shown when | Operator action |
|---|---|---|
| PR-02 | TT-301 at or above SP-10 and coal ready | Accept coal changeover |
| PR-03 | Changeover TT-301 drop, or TT-301 both bad | Select continue on diesel or HOLD |
| PR-04 | TT-301 at or above SP-44 | Accept change to main drive |
| PR-05 | S60 reached | Accept feed start |
| PR-06 | Turn failure | Turn the kiln by hand control. Confirm when done. |
| PR-07 | Main power restored in R4 | Accept return to normal rotation |
| PR-08 | Calciner permissives true | Accept calciner light-off |
| PR-09 | No rotation after power loss | Start manual barring per site procedure. Confirm. |
